newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian Iron and Steel shareholders payout set.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian Iron and Steel shareholders payout set.

text.p: The Egyptian state will give shareholders in the partly privatised firm Egyptian Iron and Steel 0.12 pounds per share for the 1995/6 financial year instead of a dividend, the firm said on Saturday .
The state is obliged by a 1984 law to give shareholders what is called a government guarantee if its companies have made a net loss and cannot distribute a dividend.

The 1995/6 balance sheet of Egyptian Iron and Steel was unavailable but the firm made a net loss of 80.3 million pounds ($23.6 million) for the 1994/5 financial year after a 69.5 million loss in the previous year.
Egyptian Iron and Steel said in a published advertisement that shareholders could pick up their money from Bank of Alexandria starting from January 26. The total amount of the payout was not known.
